notes.title: Update Demo and Steam Next Fest
notes.content:
[p]Greetings dear madmen, I know no one is reading :D, but I will still post that we are participating in Steam Next Fest and offer each of you to appreciate the madness and absurdity of my head on my game. In the full version, you'll not only be able to search for absurdities, but also catch references to your hard life and pump up your corporation office. I also updated the demo for you, fixed bugs, made more understandable and new phrases


[/p][p]I wish you an enjoyable game, leave feedback to make it even better, hugs :)[/p][p][/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45622111/7c830dd840b340d43b82e7f6ccc14c73b8ac5dc2.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update #2: Crocodile and others
notes.content:
Hi, I continue to update the first level and of course the demo in addition to new levels. Although there are few people who want to play, I will still finish what I want. Thanks to those who wrote feedback.

[b]List of changes, as if someone is reading it:[/b]
[list]
[*] Changed the appearance of the Crocodile bombardilo (now you will definitely notice it)
[*] Changed the main menu (you will notice the changes)
[*] Changed the visuals of the first level (well, the visuals, well, the location, well, you get the idea)
[*] Changed the interval of the phrases of the absurdity meter (it will not be so that you see all the phrases in a minute)
[*] Changed some texts (locations, their visuals)
[*] Added several phrases for the absurdity meter (life phrases)
[/list]

and also fixed some bugs, forgot to write down which ones

I am also waiting for you in my discord, let's chat.

[url=https://discord.gg/mPZYfsM67z]Discord[/url]

notes.title: Update #1: New Staff
notes.content:
Hello, Absurdity Hunters, if you are reading this, then thank you. This game is important to me and I hope you will like what comes out of it. There can be no logic here, but updates definitely should :)

[h3]List of changes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Added new languages ​​to the game: Ukrainian and Chinese (Simplified)
[*] Added achievements to the demo and the game
[*] Changed the time of the day change
[*] Accelerated typing of the introductory text
[*] Absurdometer phrases appear a little less often
[/list]

Leave feedback on the Demo, I hope you like it. Let's stop the Absurdities together with [b]NO LOGIC INC.[/b]
